🎇 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗹𝘆 𝗮𝘀𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝗣𝘆𝗦𝗽𝗮𝗿𝗸 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗶𝗻 𝗟𝗧𝗜𝗠𝗶𝗻𝗱𝘁𝗿𝗲𝗲

I recently came across an interesting PySpark problem that was asked in an interview at LTIMindtree . 

🎯 Problem Statement
The task was to report the number of Grand Slam tournaments won by each player, considering only the players who actually won at least one tournament.

🧠 Solution Steps:
-- Unpivot the champ Data Frame to convert tournament columns into rows.
-- Group by winner ID and count the total wins.
-- Join with the players Data Frame to get player names.
-- Filter out players with zero wins using an inner join.

data = [
 (1,'Nadal'),
 (2,'Federer'),
 (3,'Novak')
]

players_schema = StructType([
 StructField('id',IntegerType()),
 StructField('name',StringType())
 ]
)

players = spark.createDataFrame(data, schema=players_schema)

champ_data = [
 (2017,2,1,1,2),
 (2018,3,1,3,2),
 (2019,3,1,1,3)
]
champ_schema = StructType([
StructField('year',IntegerType()),
StructField('Wimbledon',IntegerType()),
StructField('Fr_open',IntegerType()),
StructField('US_open',IntegerType()),
StructField('Au_open',IntegerType())
])

champ = spark.createDataFrame(data=champ_data,schema=champ_schema)

# union the champ dataframe
champ_df = champ.select('year',col('Wimbledon').alias('winner'))\
 .unionAll(champ.select('year',col('Fr_open').alias('winner')))\
 .unionAll(champ.select('year',col('US_open').alias('winner')))\
 .unionAll(champ.select('year',col('Au_open').alias('winner')))

# grouping the dataframe
champ_group = champ_df.groupBy('winner').agg(count(lit(1)).alias('grand_slam_count')).orderBy('winner')

# Join the both dataframes

join_df = players.join(champ_group,on = players['id'] == champ_group['winner'], how = 'inner' )
join_df.select("winner","name","grand_slam_count").show()

👉 This question tests your understanding of data transformation in PySpark, especially unpivoting, grouping, and joining datasets effectively.
